title: GST: E-Way Bill "Ship To GSTIN" & Voluntary Closure live
msg: The mandatory Ship-To-GSTIN field for Bill-to/Ship-to transactions and the new voluntary E-Way Bill closure option are now live from 1 Aug 2026 (postponed from 15 Jun 2026).

title: GST: Fresh invoice numbering series required for FY 2026-27
msg: All GST-registered taxpayers must start a new, unique invoice numbering sequence for FY 2026-27 to keep audit trails clean and avoid duplicate numbers.

title: Income-tax Act, 2025 in force — new TDS section numbering
msg: The Income-tax Act, 2025 replaced the 1961 Act from 1 Apr 2026. TDS sections like 194C/194J/194H are now referenced as Section 393 with numeric payment codes — see the updated TDS Calculator.

title: App: TDS Calculator now shows old + new section codes
msg: The TDS Calculator now lists every section grouped by category and shows both the old 194-series number and the new Section 393 payment code for each.
